environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on EC2 (c5.large) behind an Application Load Balancer with no CDN. The ALB forwards all traffic directly to the origin on port 3000. No rate limiting configured. Health checks on /health. Security groups allow inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB, ALB to EC2 on port 3000. The service handles ~50 req/s baseline. Network latency from attacker to origin is <2ms (same region). No request coalescing or jitter injection middleware installed.

config.infrastructure: AWS EC2 c5.large, ALB, no CDN
